# QR

![QR function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/26-qr.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

QR with A*P=Q*R when pivot=true and A=Q*R otherwise. P is an I32 permutation matrix (empty without pivot). U16 q_option 0 complete, 1 reduced, 2 omit Q; all options alter actual computation. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: pivot=false, q_option=0.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**QR**

Factorise A=Q·R, ou A·P=Q·R avec pivotement. P est une matrice I32 ; Q option 0 complet, 1 réduit, 2 non calculé. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : pivot=false, q_option=0.

</details>
